name: Dual-Axis Stage-Orthogonal Causal Emergence Certificate
purpose: Prevent recurrence, macro-score, synergy, GWT, graph activation or output rescue from being promoted independently as emergence evidence.

A_multiscale_causal_contribution.description: Does a macro/assembly scale contribute intervention-grounded causal information/function beyond tested lower-level decompositions?
evidence: PEID or another intervention-grounded synergy measure where applicable
EI/causal-emergence profile with preregistered or held-out partition evaluation
alternative-method shadow such as SVD/dynamical reversibility where applicable

B_persistent_organization.description: Is there a recurring role-identifiable organization that forms prospectively, remains causally necessary, can be mechanistically rescued and transfers OOD?

shared_validity_gates: selection/query-plan integrity where candidate formation uses memory/graph selection
projection/reconstruction/uptake integrity where a reader mediates effects
graph prior vs workspace selection vs projection vs re-entry stage orthogonality
common-driver/confounder control for transfer-entropy or directed-prediction claims
partition/search multiple-testing control for macro-discovery claims
independent evaluation or ancestry-distinct replication before strong promotion
anti_shortcuts: bivariate transfer entropy without confounder/intervention checks
post-hoc best macro partition without held-out/null correction
representation change such as Clay-native language alone
promotion_boundary: Passing this method can support a functional emergent-organ candidate designation. It cannot establish phenomenal consciousness and does not itself grant canonical promotion authority.
